name: Objectives HUD
description: Your goals as a short checklist under the minimap, ticked off as you complete them. Turns on the minimap too.

name: Skip intro and cutscenes
description: Skip the intro and cutscenes with A, B or Start.

name: Faster pause/unpause
description: Cut the wait when pausing, unpausing and on objective banners.

name: Jukebox
description: While paused, press L or R to change the music.

name: Puzzle mode (hide power cells)
description: Hide the power cells and their counters so levels are about the puzzles. Trophies stay.

name: Minimap
description: A small map of the area around you, top right, on every level. You are the yellow dot; its pointer shows which way you are heading (a joined second player is a blue dot). Drawn from your own ROM when you build.

name: Health as head pips + energy battery
description: Health as blocks beside your animal's head and energy as a battery. Turns on the minimap too.

name: Fat Bear Mountain trophy fix
description: Make the Fat Bear Mountain trophy collectable.

name: Two-player mode (experimental)
description: Experimental. Controller 2 presses Start to join and controls a nearby animal; the camera keeps both players in view.
